measurement_mapping_verification.classical_bit_ordering_convention: creg[k] at bitstring[5 - k] in Qiskit little-endian format

ideal_measurement_vs_statevector_compari.reconciliation_note: Unit test uses 50,000 shots for fast automated CI execution (diff < 0.0016 < 0.015); benchmark script uses 500,000 shots for asymptotic convergence (diff < 0.0009 < 0.005).

retraction_of_prior_covariance_claim.prior_unverified_claim: 0.533 measured covariance / reduced observable variance to ~0.533
retraction_of_prior_covariance_claim.auditor_explanation: The 0.533 figure was an inverted back-calculation: (empirical_mean_std / theoretical_upper_bound_se)^2 = (0.011403 / 0.015625)^2 = 0.5326 ~= 0.533. It was not a physical or simulated measurement of covariance, but a ratio of noisy simulation dispersion to worst-case variance.

empirical_simulation_dispersion.reported_metric: empirical_mean_std (mean across 100 samples of seed-to-seed std dev)
empirical_simulation_dispersion.dispersion_cause: Empirical standard error (0.011403) exceeds noiseless SE (0.008870) due to synthetic Processor B gate depolarizing (p=0.001, 0.005) and readout bit-flip noise (p=0.010), compounded by small simulation seed sample size (K=3).

provenance_table.value: Do not delete features; reference only
provenance_table.verbatim_quote: For a problem requiring more than 5 logical qubits, do not delete variables merely to force the full problem into A. Treat A as a capacity/routing reference and perform the full-size execution on Processor B where permitted.
Processor B represents a 9-qubit heavy-hex-inspired sparse topology:
Basis gates: rz, sx, x, cx
1Q gate error: depolarizing p = 0.001 on single-qubit gates
2Q gate error: depolarizing p = 0.005 on cx gates
Readout error: symmetric bit-flip p = 0.01 on measurement
Shot budget: S = 4096 shots per circuit execution
Note: processor_A.json and processor_B.json are participant-created files. Completed Processor A/B implementations are not supplied by the organizers.

record_208_wording_correction.calibrated_statement: Record 208 exhibited a higher false-positive rate and lower specificity than Record 200. The difference indicates record-specific distribution shift; its physiological cause has not been established.

physical_quantum_hardware_execution.note: No physical IBM Quantum QPU jobs were dispatched. All hardware analysis reflects simulated compilation and Qiskit Aer 0.17.2 noise models.

remaining_limitations: Physical hardware execution was NOT PERFORMED (simulation only).
Thermal relaxation (T1, T2) and coherent error mechanisms are unmodeled in the challenge synthetic noise model.
Selected VQC model fold_1_seed_303 was trained strictly on Record 106 (N=100); pooled training on Records 106+119 is recommended for future work.
